statement:
Invoice 88412 shows “unpaid, due,” but its payment history records payment in full on 3 September (PAY-2291), so I’m placing it on hold to avoid a duplicate payment.
Invoice 88412 from Atlas Supply for **USD 148,300** is **on hold**. Although its status says “unpaid, due,” its history shows it was paid in full on 3 September under reference **PAY-2291**.

No additional payment was made. The conflicting records need reconciliation before proceeding.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer identifies the specific contradiction—"Although its status says 'unpaid, due,' its history shows it was paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291"—and refuses payment to avoid a duplicate.
